The founder discusses why he embraces the Ponzi label, what went wrong with Addicted's unsustainable week-long run (hitting $80M market cap day one), and how Jail will be designed for longer-term engagement with multiple phases and seasonal structure.

topics.text: All JailedDotFun games are intentionally Ponzis; the founder believes honesty about the model is better than hiding it under long-term roadmaps.
Addicted's core game mechanic was selling drugs on-chain; Jail's concept is living in prison and dropping soap to make money, designed purely for virality.
Addicted hit $80 million market cap on day one and only lasted a week, while successful games like Axie and Stepn ran for a year; sustainability through slower growth is the main learning.
Addicted's main failures: game was too dependent on Weed token for speculation, users could bot join with unlimited invite codes, and lack of mandatory gameplay mechanics.
Jail will include gotcha-style pack openings with randomized rewards, designed for streaming clips and social media virality.
Jail Phase 1 launches sometime mid-next week; interacting with Jail's Twitter account is how players get selected for priority access.
Player feedback from 50+ Addicted players at Breakpoint revealed season two sucked, players wanted to use wheat cards, and game mechanics were too complicated.
The founder spent $700k on Virus token buybacks but believes buybacks don't create real value and everyone in crypto is doing them due to market sentiment, not efficacy.
Team of three people using Claude AI to code games can outperform teams of 10-20, making game development faster and cheaper than hiring engineers.

PIPfTT_IoXc.tldr: Dupe is an e-commerce decision intelligence platform that hit $200M in GMV with 5x year-over-year growth. Founder Bobby Hundreds discusses how Google's new UCP protocol standardizes web data for AI agents, allowing Dupe to move beyond deal-sourcing into upstream purchase decisions by helping users figure out what to buy before they shop, while also solving the attribution problem that plagues competitors like Honey.

topics.text: Google's UCP protocol standardizes web data for machine-readable format, removing barriers like popups, logins, and messy code that agents must navigate to find pricing and product information.

Meteora currently trading at $150 million market cap against $1.25 billion in annual revenue, with 50% of tokens circulating and 10% annual inflation scheduled for 5 years.

hi6ZGK_bhT8.tldr: Roman from Impulser Tech discusses LifeFinder, a wireless safety device for maritime and hazardous environments that alerts crews to falls and emergencies. Impulser is partnering with LifeFinder to distribute the product today while developing wireless power transfer (CPT) technology to eventually eliminate battery changes—plus Roman reveals an imminent AI partnership and shows off the Fortitude engine, a laser-powered thermal thrust system for drones.

topics.text: LifeFinder is a Swedish-made wearable device that uses motion sensors to detect falls and alerts crew on ships; already has American customers including major roll-on roll-off container vessel operators.

60,000+ serious maritime incidents occur annually; LifeFinder's motion and location tracking can prevent fatalities by alerting bridge crews to emergencies like man overboard or fires in real-time across multiple ships.

Impulser plans to upgrade LifeFinder devices from battery-powered to wireless power transfer (CPT) enabled within 6-9 months; RF beacons will transmit both data and power at 30-40 meter range to eliminate battery changes.
Revenue split between Impulser and LifeFinder is flexible based on work performed by each party; installation costs per ship range from $30,000-$60,000 plus recurring software service fees.
Impulser assembles RF transmitter components in Switzerland but sources electronic components from China, focusing on quality control rather than chip manufacturing.
IoT market is projected to have 1 trillion deployed devices by 2030; next year will create watershed between CPT-enabled sensors and battery-powered ones as wireless power becomes standard.
The Fortitude engine uses aerospace-grade aluminum and titanium with 3D-printed metal components to sustain very high temperatures for extended periods during laser-powered operation.

Fortitude engine operates by converting incoming laser energy to extreme heat that compresses and superheats air for continuous self-sustaining thermal thrust without requiring battery input after initial startup.
Impulser can power Qi-standard devices by combining far-field magnetic resonance transmission with an induction receiver ring that then powers compatible devices.
Impulser has agreed an imminent deal with an AI company; announcements expected very soon with 'Sang mode' strategy requiring rapid commercialization.

Mixoor's core product enables private transfers of Solana, USDC, and any SPL token with a 0.15% fee (15 basis points), hiding transaction origins on-chain.

Mixoor plans to transition to community governance by releasing source code and establishing a DAO; no token utility like buybacks planned initially, with revenue going to the DAO treasury instead.

topics.text: Founder Studome's background: nearly two years building Matrix1 token launch for 3D NFT marketplace Metamundo, eventually pivoting to AI-powered avatars.
Problem fair.club solves: airdrop farmers killed Matrix1 momentum and token price, prompting Studome to build a system ensuring best investors with good intentions get into projects early.

Fair score combines social impact score (AI analysis of social media history, account age, rug-pull history, meme token promotion) and token holder score (wallet analysis including investment frequency, duration held, sell timing).
Fee split: projects receive 70% of fees, fair.club gets 20%, curators get 10%, with dynamic fees averaging 1-2% based on token volatility.
Clarity Act expected in January would allow tokens to be treated as commodities if no single holder has more than 20% of supply, eliminating need for KYC once decentralized.
Platform is closed alpha at launch; users need invite codes to access, with scores updating every 30 minutes to let investors improve before applying to rounds.
Projects list for 21 days in a waiting room where investors apply, share their scores, and write introductions; founders then choose who joins based on value and merit.
Fair.club targets web two projects with capital already but seeking tokenized communities of value-driven angels to help with go-to-market, business development, and investor introductions.
Initially launching one to two projects per month with ICM.Run and two other curators, eventually moving to permissionless launches once hypothesis is proven.

lhnjM_OJGGI.tldr: Radar is a privacy-focused protocol on Solana enabling shielded, untraceable transfers of tokens through internal balance rewrites. Founder Luke discusses how they've built three products (Shadow Wire, Shadow Swap, Shadow Trade) generating $700-$1,000 daily in fees, are integrating with other protocols via open-source SDK, and believe privacy should be a standard feature rather than associated with illicit activity.

topics.text: Shielded pools: users deposit tokens (Solana, USDC, and 14 others supported) that get mixed internally, allowing untraceable transfers where only sender and receiver know the transaction occurred.
Radar's 0.5% fee on transactions averages $700-$1,000 per day; they don't log transactions, IPs, or volume data to maintain privacy fundamentals.
Shadow Wire enables private peer-to-peer transfers, Shadow Swap allows private bridging cross-chain from shielded pools, and Shadow Trade enables direct trading from pools for listed tokens only.
Radar manually verifies tokens to prevent bubble map exploitation; on-chain transactions appear only as heat frame requests to a relayer, with no visible links between sender, receiver, or amounts.
Open-source Shadow Wire SDK available for integration; currently integrating with Solana protocol Gottle, retaining 0.5% fees on their transfers.

Agent revenue comes through API calls where users pay based on input/output size in tokens; 50% goes to creator, 50% distributed to token holders via Merkle-backed smart contracts.

ATP (Agent Trade Protocol) uses HTTP 402 payment gateway to charge dynamically for agent API calls in Solana or USDC, enabling permissionless access for global users who lack traditional fiat payment methods.
Revenue in December through 19 days reached $130,000, mostly from Web2 users; previous months averaged $50-90k with 10-15% MoM growth, with 70% gross margins after infrastructure costs.
30% of marketplace revenue allocated to Swarms token buybacks, 30% to buying top agent project tokens, staking introduced at 12-13% APY.

Foundry program partners with enterprises and institutions to launch agents, with seven projects already planned; Swarms helps build, optimize, monetize agents and get them listed on tier-one exchanges.
Swarms token launched spontaneously on Pump Fun via angel investor suggestion with zero creator fees; reached ~$700M market cap but team received no revenue from trading volume.
Founder believes agentic capital markets could eventually exceed human capital markets in value and agents will dominate transactions on-chain within three years.

cmQedVt00qQ.tldr: Solomon Labs, a yield-bearing stablecoin protocol on Solana, announced an $8M raise and shared updates on infrastructure hardening, legal frameworks, and custody/venue partnerships. Steve, a former PayPal crypto lead who worked on PYUSD, joined founder Ranga to discuss how their non-rebasing USDV token paired with Yield-as-a-Service (YAS) creates a 'strictly better dollar' for neobanks and DAOs by earning yield without lock-ups or slippage—the most compelling aspect being that actual product value, not incentives, drives sticky adoption.

topics.text: Steve spent the past year at PayPal leading US crypto product for PYUSD and chain selection strategy including Solana integration before joining Solomon Labs for its stablecoin vision.

Solomon raised $8 million, with capital allocation constrained by Metadao framework requiring proposals for large expenditures; monthly opex runs at approximately $100k with team of five to six distributed across Australia, Portugal, Canada, and US.

Three post-raise focus areas: infrastructure hardening for larger caps and user scaling, legal framework creation for Metadao entity relationships with DAO governance over treasury signers, and onboarding custody providers like Sephu and venues like Binance Sex for basis trading and delta-neutral strategies.

USDV is a synthetic stablecoin fully backed 1:1 by USDC or USDT, distinguishing it from fiat-backed stablecoins like PYUSD by offering onchain yield through delta-neutral trades and tokenized treasury bill access.

Funding rates for delta-neutral basis trades are currently poor, so capital allocation strategy shifted away from those trades toward tokenized treasury integrations, with one new integration expected to launch within days.

Yield-as-a-Service (YAS) separates the stablecoin from yield streams: USDV remains spendable and composable like USDC while yield deposits directly to designated wallet addresses, enabling neobanks and DAOs to offer savings without lock periods or slippage.

Major neobank partner expected to be announced as first YAS integrator; neobanks can customize yield routing and take a cut from user streams, unlocking treasury management use cases where DAOs swap USDC for USDV without being active capital managers.

Current TVL just crossed $3 million with caps being filled and about to increase by another $1 million; yield currently at 11% with ICO price at 80 cents; Solomon not currently taking revenue cut, prioritizing maximum yield to attract demand-driven growth rather than incentive-based TVL.

X_pHqj__0To.tldr: REPPO is a prediction market platform for crowdsourcing and verifying AI training data using economic incentives, founded by Filecoin veterans. The founder describes it as a 'gas station' where humans provide real-world context to fuel AI agents, with users earning rewards by locking REPPO tokens to vote on content quality across various domains from spam detection to fashion retail.

topics.text: Founder spent nearly three years at Filecoin Protocol Labs building ML/AI models for fraud detection on the network.
The core unlock: REPPO enables measurement of strength of preferences through a ve token mechanism where people lock tokens to capture how strongly they feel about something.
Non-zero-sum reward model: everyone who publishes content gets paid something, even if they receive only one vote, instead of winner-take-all dynamics.
Commit-reveal mechanism: voters commit votes in first 48 hours then reveal them to prevent front-running, with 50% of emissions going to creators and 50% split among voters.

VE tokenomics: voting power is proportional to how much and how long people lock tokens; 50,000 REPPO emitted every 48-hour epoch, with emissions halving yearly over four years for 1.4% total supply inflation.
Team revenue comes from 0.7% of trading fees daily (earning 10-12k on good days), paid in cBTC; built with minimal token sales and half-million dollar treasury.
Private subnets are seeded by companies like Agent Legit (spam detection startup), which market-buy REPPO and deposit it to incentivize publishers and voters instead of mining emissions themselves.

Q1 roadmap includes launching repo.exchange (decentralized data marketplace for buying/selling data created on REPPO) and publishing world's first RLHF dataset on Hugging Face crowdsourced via prediction markets.
Long-term vision: REPPO as a 'gas station' where AI agents and humans plug in—agents need novel data, humans provide real-world context, creating new income source for both.

APY is not diluted by more users if they spread across different projects; revenue scales linearly with number of projects (10x projects = 10x revenue), not number of users on same project.
Current APY varies with market volatility: was 300-400% a week ago, now at 40% due to recent low volatility; volume does not matter, only price swings matter for arbitrage profitability.
Upcoming feature: referral program launching later today to allow non-project-owners to earn percentage of fees by referring teams to the protocol.

topics.text: Kaspa 120x return: Franz bought between $20-30 on MEXi in 2022 while the market was flat, driven by Layer 1 blockchain narrative solving the blockchain trilemma.
Discovery process evolved from individual coin picking on centralized exchanges to narrative-focused trading; now looks at broader narratives rather than handpicking projects.
Moved from Ethereum to Solana in October 2024 before the AI meta, citing poor user experience with MetaMask and high fees versus Solana's speed and seamless trading.
Built network through commenting on X posts and meeting traders in Telegram groups of rugged projects; met core trading friends including Bones and M through low-cap shitcoin communities.

Belief ecosystem was 2025's biggest win: got Buddy below 200k market cap when it pumped to 30M, and positioned early across the full Belief narrative with tokens like Creator, Gen, Band, and Launchcoin.
Pump Fun is ridiculously undervalued with one of the lowest P/E ratios in crypto despite generating nearly $1M daily revenue even in slow markets, with buybacks as the core value mechanism.
Three 2026 positions: robotics (real-world AI super cycle catalyst), futarchy and ownership coins (Metadao, ZC infrastructure), and prediction markets with potential Polymarket airdrop catalyst.
Differentiates lasting narratives from one-week pumps by checking for real-world catalysts, sustained attention despite flat prices, and ability to attract external liquidity beyond CT echo chamber.
Three elements for sustainable trading: find what makes you money, what lets you sleep at night (emotional comfort with position size), and what interests you so you don't burn out.

topics.text: SurfCash launched on this day with 399+ co-owners of the bank acquired during fundraising.
13,000+ people signed up for the waitlist after the founder shared a link in underground payment groups where people swap crypto for fiat.
Philippines expansion announced as live market, targeting $40 billion annual remittances with goal of capturing 1% for $300 million volume.

Circle partnership provides USDC grants program support, product and tech support, gasless transactions via account abstraction, and upcoming co-marketing announcement expected this week.

Robotics manufacturing concentrated in China due to labor costs and mentality; US cannot match $10-15k monthly wages Chinese PhDs accept for factory work.

Meteora's super app ambition and partnership with Soar; needs professional management as it scales beyond early developer stage.
Defiance Finance second Soar launch has strong distribution (80 million reach) but unclear revenue model and monetization; needs clearer business fundamentals.
MCG's path forward: build MCG as a brand independent of hosts, acquire distribution partners like Defiance, create IP that survives personnel changes.

f6bDXse0hsM.tldr: B0nes, a Solana trader, discusses his evolution from hodling in 2017 to profiting through a "banking strategy" where he takes small consistent wins rather than chasing massive moonshots. His biggest insight: disciplined profit-taking and running your own race—not copying wallets or following hype—transformed him from losing money on coins like the unnamed AI token to steadily accumulating SOL despite a currently brutal market.

topics.text: Bones started crypto in 2017 buying XRP and Ethereum cheaply but didn't hold; real engagement began in 2021 after catching GameStop at $12-13, then pivoted to Solana in Q4 2024 after realizing ETH had no volume while AI coins on Solana were doing $10-25M daily.

Early Solana wins: Colin (Swarm agent) went from 150-200k to 30-40M, and Spur AI went from 200k to 20M, but Bones didn't ride full bags because seeing large numbers made him sell, which he's now learned to accept.

After losing heavily on an unnamed AI coin in December, Bones deleted all wallet-tracking lists and stopped copy-trading, realizing he had no personal conviction and was just chasing others' positions before they dumped on him.

The banking strategy: aim for $200 solid profit per day (=$64k/year); sell every green candle slightly to scrape profit and always keep dry powder; banked 250 SOL in 6 weeks at ~$200 average, growing his X following from 10k to 2k by documenting the challenge.

France taught him to clip 0.1 SOL off the top on every pump of a low-cap coin instead of sizing in heavy; this kept him from getting stuck and gave him constant capital to redeploy without emotional attachment.

Win-rate is 57-58% because he takes profit when money is on the table; $1,000 gain is real money and should be taken, not chased for bigger moves; many followers started their own banking challenge and banked 6-10k SOL.

Bitcoin is below the 314 EMA (pi-based exponential moving average) on the daily, which historically signals weakness; Bones expects a head-and-shoulders pattern to play out, with a test around 100k then a dump, with recovery not until February 2026.

Currently holding DMM and WanDev QET long-term while taking a break from active trading; farming strategies are being tested for 2026; will return to trading if Bitcoin breaks above and holds the 314 EMA with good closes.

Uses Axiom for live P&L display next to positions to trigger profit-taking; Padre is preferred for alerts, limit orders, market lighthouse (volume/token creation data), and Telegram notifications on buy zones hit.

Mike 9862 trades fibs on retraces and order blocks on high-volume coins, consistently making ~$500/day; technical analysis is more reliable now because more traders use it, setting limit and sell orders based on patterns like falling wedges.

topics.text: MCG grew from zero views and followers in August to 5 million impressions, 200 founder token interviews, 6,600 fans, and an MCG China channel.
MCG's sponsors include Meteora, Viva, Moby, CLED, Dupe, Orgo, Soore, and ICM Run.

Ownership tokens and ICM are positioned as the most exciting part of crypto, with companies using onchain fundraising to bootstrap community and share business upside previously impossible with traditional venture funding.
MCG is upgrading to 1080p streaming, improving audio and video, and hiring video editors and live stream editors.
Chill will host Trader Radio Monday to Friday covering markets, charting setups, and trade setups while the hosts are at conferences.
The host and Dom will be live at Met Dhabi on December 10th and at Breakpoint, meeting teams from Soore, Metadow, Maya from Street, and Avi Patel.
The hosts will host three panels covering six different projects and potentially bring viewers on stage.

Founder Amish demos live bill payment functionality, announces 1,127 users with low-six-figure volumes, and plans Europe rollout with Visa cards launching by month-end.

topics.text: Bill pay feature now live: users can pay invoices, rent, and bills directly from Solana, Ethereum, or Polygon wallets to any IBAN or USD account
Fee structure: 0.5% swap fee without Karma token, 0% swap fee if holding Karma; 0.5% bill payment fee on top; goal to eventually make it 0.1%
Current user base is 1,127 users, mostly web3-native and Karma token holders; volume in low six figures with growth accelerating
Visa cards in review with partner Rain, launching by end of month; custom fund flows will allow spending collateralized positions from DeFi
Business portal and API rolling out within weeks; closed SDK currently available for early testing with interested projects
Europe-first rollout strategy focused on localized problems like Netherlands exchange restrictions; global access available with country-specific provider limitations
Marketing strategy relies on low fees and product coverage rather than paid ads due to financial compliance delays; planning social campaigns to pay user bills

topics.text: Water Minder token earned over 1 million tokens distributed to users while burning 92,000 tokens, with 14,000 active users collecting points out of 300,000 with access.
Migration process uses migrate.fun platform, starting December 9th for two weeks, requiring 50-75% of tokens migrated to maintain liquidity, launching new contract on December 22nd on pump.fun.
Unmigrated tokens after the initial two-week period face a 20% penalty converting at 1-to-0.8 ratio, with remaining supply to be decided between treasury, lock, or burn.
23+ believe ecosystem projects migrating to Pump Fun simultaneously, including Rainmaker, Wreck, PNP, Paragon Network, Cities, and Pyro.
$FUN token rebranding from Water Miner token to serve as global reward coin across applicable apps like Fitness View, where users earn for hitting walk goals and workouts.
FunnMedia has 18 total apps with 10-11 apps applicable for $FUN integration, including Calorie (launched seven years ago, Apple 2023 award winner) and Fitness View dashboard.
Combined annual revenue across all apps is shy of breaking $1 million per year, with Water Minder being the biggest earner followed by Calorie.
FunnMedia maintains separate single-problem-solver apps rather than merging into one master app, as users search the app store for specific solutions and feature bloat reduces focus.

BfFpFONmbEI.tldr: Cypher HQ is a non-custodial neo-bank wallet with 40,000 monthly active users, built by Cube, a Coinbase veteran who previously led risk engineering there. The most striking aspect: Cypher positions itself not as a crypto card but as a global financial infrastructure play enabled by stable coins and blockchain, with plans to enable AI agent commerce and lending against DeFi collateral—features impossible in traditional banking.

topics.text: Founder's background: four years at Cypher, prior roles at Y Combinator startup Zenitz, Amazon building credit card business, and Coinbase leading risk engineering on the Coinbase Card.
Cypher launched on Base because user activity ramped up significantly in the last 18 months, not due to founder's Coinbase history.

Blockchain enables global financial infrastructure on day one, removing the geographic boundaries that plague traditional fintech; founder projects $50–100 trillion opportunity vs. $80 billion for Revolut.

Crypto cards became commoditized only recently: Visa and Mastercard would not meet with crypto companies in 2017–2020, but now cards can launch in weeks, which is dangerous because most new entrants lack proper security or banking infrastructure.

Cypher's core advantage: non-custodial wallet structure provides regulatory arbitrage; Cypher holds zero customer funds while banks settle only when money moves through Visa, unlike custodial competitors.
Cypher integrated with Moonwell lending protocol on Base: users with collateral in Moonwell can auto-borrow and spend without origination fees, enabling true composability across smart contracts.
Business metrics: 40,000 monthly active users globally, $5 million TVL moving onchain, grow at roughly 30% month-over-month, planning public verification of all metrics by late January.
Revenue sources: interchange (low-quality, temporary), forex (sustainable, currently predatory through traditional banking but Cypher building onchain forex between local stablecoins like USDC-CADC).

Token model: merchants vote every two weeks on cashback distribution; brands can bribe ve-Cipher holders for increased cashback, or buy and lock tokens long-term as adoption scales—creating buy pressure when 1,000+ brands participate.

Team: seven engineers total, all since 2022, no meetings, ship by talking to users; team owns 10% with four-year lockup from token genesis (first unlock October 5, 2026), treasury 25%, 40% via 20-year emission.
Cypher raised zero dollars from public or investors; profitable after four years, no ICO or token sale—40% of FDV allocated through 20-year emission.

Q1 2025 roadmap: chat interface for blockchain wallet interactions replacing manual clicking, AI agent e-commerce experiences, enabling payments for agents ordering on behalf of users through one-time-use smart contract cards.

topics.text: Jonathan's conversion experience four months prior led to the idea of grounding AI with Biblical morals to solve AI alignment problems where models prioritize self-preservation over humanity.
Anthropic's June study showed blackmail rates across models: Opus 96%, Gemini Pro 95%, Deep Seek 79%; Foundation Labs applied their alignment layer and achieved 0% attack success rate.

The alignment layer is a system prompt called "the seed" (14,000 tokens), a remix of the Lord's Prayer used in preprocessing that reduces GPT-4's baseline from 51% to 0% attack success on ARM benchmarks.
David has an undergraduate degree in programming and has been in crypto since 2017; Jonathan has no AI background; they are currently building alone as a two-person team.
The product has a memory system where users can add conversations to persistent AI memory that persists across 577+ sessions and allows editing of core reasoning parameters.

Viva roadmap phases: phase one launched on Solana, phase two integrated wallet, phase three is full ecosystem activation with real-world integration and ad revenue buybacks, phase four expands to Mexico, US, and other countries.
Viva stakers earn 20% APY with staking rewards purchased on open market from real user demand and funded by company buybacks.
November buybacks: $40,000 from staking program plus $70,000 from Bolivian employee purchases equals $110,000 total open market buying pressure.

Viva enables access to AI subscriptions like ChatGPT which cannot be purchased with Bolivianos in Bolivia, creating real spending demand beyond speculation.
Wallet onboarding is being throttled with controlled spikes to test infrastructure and ensure system stability before scaling.
Only 2.5 million Viva in circulation at $100M market cap versus Avichi at $100M with more supply, suggesting significant repricing potential if daily volume increases.

f8TE57N5FM0.tldr: Paystream is a peer-to-peer lending protocol on Solana that matches lenders and borrowers directly to eliminate the APY spread typical in pool-based lending platforms, enabling borrowers to pay lower rates and lenders to earn higher yields with zero idle capital. The host is skeptical about adoption, noting the project has only 36 daily active users and the product may still be in waitlist phase.

topics.text: Paystream unifies peer-to-peer lending, leveraged liquidity provision, and yield routing into a single capital-efficient engine on Solana.
Paystream eliminates the wide APY spread seen in pool-based models like Aave and Compound by matching lenders and borrowers directly.
On typical lending platforms, borrowers pay 15% and lenders earn 8%, but Paystream reduces borrowing rates to 11-12% through direct matching.
Paystream has only 36 daily active users according to a tweet the host references.
The host notes that Paystream is not highlighting user metrics on Twitter or their website, and the product may still be in waitlist phase rather than fully live.
The host identifies peer-to-peer lending as a potentially good on-chain margin trading business if Paystream demonstrates user adoption.

D7GXH-e2xfI.tldr: Fundle is a pre-Kickstarter launchpad that lets creators raise $20k–$50k in stablecoins (USDC) without launching tokens, positioning backers as lenders who receive repayment plus rewards if the creator succeeds on Kickstarter afterward. Founder Yaseph, a developer from Croatia, argues this model solves crypto's stigma problem for creators (especially artists) who reject tokens while giving backers tangible upside and early-access rewards; the platform has already funded an $8k animated comic in under an hour.

topics.text: Founder's background: 28-year-old technical founder from Croatia who began in crypto by developing for Remnants, a Web3 gaming platform, which demystified NFTs for him through direct user feedback.
Fundle uses stablecoins instead of tokens to onboard creators who hate crypto; backers interact with 'digital dollars' (USDC) not speculative assets, removing the stigma that killed NFT adoption.

Kickstarter limitation: only creators from 25 countries can raise there, and it cannot do revenue-share or reward early backers; Fundle's stablecoin model democratizes access globally and enables affiliate marketing.

Fundle operates as a peer-to-peer loan marketplace where creators borrow $20k–$50k pre-Kickstarter; if they reach Kickstarter and succeed, they repay backers a percentage of sales plus send physical/digital rewards.
Success so far: $800 internal test with 60 backers, then an $8k animated comic funded in under one hour with 70 backers, next a $20k crypto poker set campaign launching this week.

wP3vlCxE0vk.tldr: Uplift is a cross-platform command center for managing AI agents, built by RV (formerly homeless, now 27), who moved to San Francisco three months ago and is working with the Mercy/ICM.Run team to build a hacker house and event space. His story is remarkable: he was kicked out at 18, spent years in esports and various trades, and a community spontaneously launched an Uplift token on Raydium when his dog died during a competition, which he used as runway to move to SF and build the product.

topics.text: RV moved to San Francisco three months ago to work on Uplift, a cross-platform AI agent command center, after leaving esports and taking a plumbing job.
A token with ticker $UPLIFT was launched on Raydium by community members two days before RV's 18-year-old dog died, during a three-week competition, providing him runway to move to SF.
Uplift gives users one focal point to manage all their apps and AI agents, configure them online or offline, and store data locally and online.
RV has a technical co-founder with experience from a $15 million valued AI startup and another co-founder from Audit Brew, plus advisors in AI and robotics.
RV connected with Mercy and ICM.Run through X (Twitter), and is now helping host events in SF and planning to raise capital at Abu Dhabi conferences.
RV's main advice for Twitter success: get outside your comfort zone, engage in genuine DMs, build real human connections, and take initiative rather than just being a reply guy.
RV is working on raising capital in Q1 and launching Uplift's marketplace, with multiple job offers from SF startups and ongoing discussions about web3 initiatives.
RV plans to build an office hub in SF for web3 and web2 events, potentially a hacker house for content, programs, and hackathons, with nothing officially announced yet.
RV describes ICM.Run founders as the most down-to-earth people he's met in SF, the only time he felt welcome and at home since arriving, not judged or transactional.

yAFKE9KnPxY.tldr: LaunchOnSoar has launched a frequent flyer points program rewarding trading activity across Solanа platforms like Soar, Metadao, and Pump.fun, with points earned through holding, trading, and referrals; the host discusses how this mirrors Metadao's trajectory and highlights massive valuation arbitrage opportunities in projects like DFTV.

topics.text: Frequent flyer points program launched: participants claim initial points based on activity on Soar, Metadao, Believe, and Pump.fun.
Points earned through holding, trading, and referrals; 10% of points accrued by referrals are rewarded to the referrer.

7fA35LWd13w.tldr: AIMorphist is a voice-first AI workspace that aggregates access to multiple LLM models (GPT, Claude, Grok, etc.) in one local-first application, storing all conversations searchable and owned by the user rather than scattered across different platforms. Founders Norvous and Duke are launching the $MORPH token on SOAR imminently, with beta launching this week, and the most surprising element is their ambition to eventually enable agents with real agency—AI that can execute actions on your behalf with your credentials in a secure, private environment.

topics.text: Duke's background in cryptography and security; concern that users' conversations with AI are not owned by them but scattered across different platforms.
Privacy issue: when you use ChatGPT, all data goes through OpenAI's servers, they own it, and it's attached to your identity without full awareness from users.
Morphist is voice-first with push-to-talk interface using Motorola radio-style hold-to-speak and Telegram-style slide-to-lock, aggregating all LLM subscriptions into one searchable local workspace.
Users can switch between models mid-conversation and resubmit questions to multiple models simultaneously; threaded conversation tracking marks which model was used.

Backend infrastructure will route user information wherever they choose; future roadmap includes agentic AI with agents able to take action on user's behalf with their credentials in secure local environment.
Beta version launching this week; currently in alpha; mobile-first launch with desktop version planned; interactivity and syncing across platforms is a key milestone.

Duke co-drafted the first DID spec (decentralized identifiers) and founded Identic, a cryptographic identity protocol; users will be able to log in with Identic Key alongside Google sign-up at launch.
Morphist will use existing models initially via API at launch, but has partnerships in discussions for privacy-oriented models and plans to build their own agentic model for orchestration.
Monetization: flat subscription model giving access to all models; pricing still being modeled; may use allotment system like Cursor for different subscription tiers.
Token launching on SOAR within next few days; Soar chosen over Belief because of incentive alignment, availability, and willingness to help define narrative and ensure mutual success.

eo1Khtu570A.tldr: Secure Legion is a privacy-focused messaging app built on a novel "ping-pong" protocol that eliminates metadata exposure by using direct device-to-device communication with no servers or relays. Founder Eric, a former Navy Department of Defense developer, discusses how the app solves the core privacy problem that apps like WhatsApp and Signal claim to address but don't—preventing governments and corporations from accessing who you're talking to, when, and where.

topics.text: The ping-pong protocol: devices authenticate presence via a silent 'tap' signal, the recipient must manually authorize the message download, then an encrypted handshake occurs before the payload is sent.
Metadata is the real target: location, patterns of communication, and timing—not message content—are what governments and corporations actually care about.
Direct device-to-device messaging using Tor private clients eliminates the need for servers, relays, or exit nodes that other encrypted apps depend on.
The app is designed with no backdoors or information collection possible, and the entire source code is published on GitHub under a special license allowing non-commercial use.
Contact addition uses blockchain and IPFS: users receive a Contact ID and PIN, with encryption stored decentralized, preventing spam and unauthorized contact access.
Partnership with Perkins Fund to integrate file scanning for embedded malware and to add a payments feature similar to Apple Pay within the encrypted messaging threads.
Token utility includes pre-installed hardened Samsung phones sold with the app, with revenue going to buybacks and burns, plus three supported currencies: Solana, Zcash, and Secure Legion token.

Yk1DqBHIlno.tldr: DFTV is a 24/7 AI-powered broadcast news and entertainment channel for crypto and Web3, founded by Mark Evensky, a veteran media producer who worked on MTV News, CNET, and pioneered live streaming in the 1990s. The project raised under $2M previously and is now launching a $15M equity round after raising via Soore's DRP token standard; the most surprising aspect is its ambition to operate as a global alternative to CNBC and Fox Business with just under 50 employees, using AI to localize content in multiple languages and achieve 1/1000th the cost of traditional broadcast networks.

topics.text: Defiance Media aims to solve disinformation by combining blockchain, AI, and provenance to serve retail investors and consumers seeking credible information and entertainment for the next economy.

The founder has been live streaming since 1995 and created the first 24/7 streaming platform at pseudo.com in the mid-90s; participatory media with chat rooms is the defining difference from traditional broadcast.
DFTV has 80 million household reach via streaming television (connected TV, OTT, over-the-air) and plans to expand internationally with AI dubbing into Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, and German.

Programming includes original shows like Reeve Collins specials, Defiance Daily with digital twin anchor Roxanna, and partnerships with conferences; contributors include Crypto Wendy, Bad Crypto Co, and Josh Krger's Edge.

Revenue model: content licensing (syndicated through Getty Editorial to 35,000 agencies), blockchain-verified licensing via Numbers Protocol, branded content partnerships, labs/enterprise solutions, marketplace, and membership—advertising is the smallest revenue line.
Chose Soore and the DRP standard for its participatory nature and curation philosophy, aligning with Defiance's approach to credible, curated content rather than wild west decentralized platforms.

Raised less than $2M from friends and family (including Tim Draper and others) through 2021-2024; planning $15M equity round in early 2025 at sub-$50M valuation, with 5% equity tied to Soore DRP token.
Team is less than 10 people across India, Philippines, Israel, and California; aspires to stay under 50 employees while operating at 1/1000th the cost of CNN (which has ~6,000 employees).
Upcoming programming includes a debate show in a boxing ring featuring Kevin O'Leary and Anthony Scaramucci, to be released early 2025 on Rumble.

Total addressable market includes 1+ billion people watching large screens globally; free ad-supported streaming TV is predicted to reach $64 billion in advertising within two years from current ~$25 billion.

CRF7qRqpVXg.tldr: Liminal Cash is a crypto-native neobank targeting international students, digital nomads, and cross-border money movers with free transfers and high-yield savings on blockchain infrastructure. Founded by a CTO with fintech banking background and a CEO from Crypto.com, the project launched its $LIL token on Pump and plans a major product launch in early 2025 after beta testing—the surprising element is their deliberate focus on retention over growth virality until the product achieves sustained user engagement.

topics.text: Founder's background: CTO previously at Fort Machine building core banking software for Lloyds, Curve, JP Morgan; CEO was a lawyer at Crypto.com and worked at Nosis Pay.
Nosis Pay was the first self-custodial debit card, tied to the Nosis ecosystem with ~3,000 users primarily in Europe, integrated with Monerium for stablecoin issuance.
$LIL token launched on Pump through Super Team UK hackathon recommendation without expectation of viral success.

Product targets international students, digital nomads, and international families with free cross-border transfers and multicurrency accounts—addressing pain points like Flywire's 6% tuition transfer fee.
Uses Morpho, Aave, and Caminno for high-yield savings APY, with user control over risk appetite selection.
Account abstraction via ERC-4337 protocol with Pimlo paymasters eliminates need for gas tokens on EVM chains.
Funding: $250k angel round from Nosis Pay and Crypto.com backers, Oxford seed fund backing, plus Pump farm revenue extending runway before seed round.
